description: A midroll of 12 segments on every token. The page's token (popout, F-12) gets it 15 segments after its first poll; every backup token gets it at its own first poll (`breaksSooner` 15), so each backup Purple asks during the page's break lists live segments up to the moment it was asked and ad segments from there: no backup is clean and Purple gives the page's playlist merged with the backups' (E5, B-012). The page's token dates each segment 1.5 s earlier than the backup tokens (B-057), as after stitched breaks on twitch.tv. Run with the backup types `site` and `embed` (a `popout` backup would be numbered and dated as the page's)
